source_control.semantic_result: The source supports an explicit dialogue-and-agency frame rather than an abstract relation noun plus a metaphysical remain predicate.

decisions.source_basis: Pinned Eldamo introductory course; later har- direction associated with PE17/162 and UT/305 in the course discussion
decisions.limits: The supported direction is sit or stay in a place or situation. It does not establish remain oneself, preserve identity, or continue as an unreplaced living source.
Continue, tarry, rest and dwell must not be collapsed into philosophical identity persistence.
Must not appear in a candidate title or philosophical frame.
The relation is to be represented by explicit participant actions, not by an invented compact noun.
